Оплата через 60 дней после подписания акта.

all_findings.reason: Исполнитель несёт ответственность без ограничения суммы.
all_findings.original_text: Supplier shall be liable without limitation for any damages arising from or related to this Agreement.
all_findings.suggested_rewrite: Supplier's total liability arising from or related to this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by Client in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim.

all_findings.reason: Оплата через 60 дней после получения счёта — это долгий срок для исполнителя.
all_findings.original_text: Client shall pay all undisputed invoices within sixty (60) days of receipt.
all_findings.suggested_rewrite: Client shall pay all undisputed invoices within fifteen (15) days of receipt.

all_findings.reason: Все права на интеллектуальную собственность, включая предшествующие наработки, переходят заказчику.
all_findings.original_text: All intellectual property developed during the project shall belong exclusively to the Client, including all pre-existing materials used therein.
all_findings.suggested_rewrite: All intellectual property developed specifically for this project shall belong to the Client upon full payment. Supplier retains all rights to pre-existing materials and generic tools used in the project.
